content_sections.heading: About MSSDS
content_sections.text: The Meghalaya State Skill Development Society is a society of the Government of Meghalaya with its office at Grove Site Building 3rd Floor, Keating Road, Shillong, Meghalaya - 793001. The Program Associate – Accounts will handle the day-to-day accounting, voucher, PFMS and statutory compliance work of the society's projects and institutional accounts.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Office address as printed on the notice: Grove Site Building 3rd Floor, Keating Road, Shillong, Meghalaya - 793001. The notice does not mention whether the application should be sent by post or delivered by hand, and gives no instruction for the envelope. The notice lists the phone number 0364-2502243 and the email [email protected] on its letterhead; it does not invite applications by email.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Bachelor's Degree in Commerce (B. Com) from a recognized university/institution. Minimum 3-5 years of hands-on operational experience in accounting, bookkeeping, and financial execution. Practical, working experience with Tally ERP/Tally Prime and PFMS (Public Financial Management System) is mandatory. Demonstrated experience in handling statutory compliance (GST compilation, TDS calculation/upload support) and maintaining voucher systems. Preferred Background: Experience in Government Projects, State Missions, Development Sector Programs, or Externally Aided Projects (EAP) supported by World Bank, ADB, JJM, Rural Development, or Livelihood Missions. Technical Skills: High proficiency in Tally ERP/Prime, PFMS portal workflows, MS Excel (advanced formulas, data compilation), and MS Office. Procedural Knowledge: Understanding of Government Financial Rules (GFR), double-entry accounting, and eOffice file movements. Operational Capabilities: Strong attention to detail, accuracy in data entry, invoice verification, and capability to manage structured filing systems. Soft Skills: Effective written and verbal communication skills, cooperative team spirit, and capability to interact professionally with government stakeholders. The age limit is 21 to 35 yrs. The notice does not mention a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. The notice states that the post is extendable to the post of Asst. Manager with a Pay Scale of 32,100/- based on experience and eligibility. All applicants must ensure that they meet the prescribed eligibility criteria before submitting their applications. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: MSSDS Program Associate – Accounts Job Description
content_sections.text: Job purpose as printed: the Program Associate (Accounts) will independently handle day-to-day operational accounting, voucher maintenance, digital filing, and statutory compliance support. Record daily financial transactions by preparing and posting accurate Journal Entries in accordance with standard accounting principles. Maintain and update General Ledgers, Sub-ledgers, and verify Trial Balance figures periodically. Prepare monthly Receipts and Payment along with Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS) for all project and institutional bank accounts. Execute hands-on accounting entries in Tally ERP / Tally Prime (Mandatory). Create and manage chart of accounts, ledgers, vendor accounts, and project-specific heads in Tally. Maintain strict voucher management workflows within the software environment. Prepare data files and assist in the timely filing of GST returns. Process TDS (Tax Deducted at Source) deductions on vendor invoices, generate payment challans, and assist in periodic TDS return uploads. Maintain statutory registers, tax deduction records, and compliance documentation for internal and external verification. Verify, code, and process Payment Vouchers, Receipt Vouchers, and Journal Vouchers with complete supporting documentation (invoices, receipts, approval notes). Organize systematic physical and digital filing systems to ensure audit-ready financial records. Perform day-to-day transaction processing on the PFMS portal (Mandatory), including vendor mapping, payment generation (EAT module/PFMS workflows), and fund tracking. Assist in generating PFMS-based expenditure reports and Utilisation Certificate (UC) schedules. Process finance-related files in alignment with Government Financial Rules (GFR) and organizational financial guidelines. Utilize eOffice / eFile systems for digital file movement, record tracking, and official correspondence processing. Liaise with government departments, financial institutions, and partner agencies for routine operational coordination.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The prescribed Application Form (Annexure), signed, with a recent passport size photograph pasted on it. Relevant testimonials and certificates. Marksheets. Supporting documents for Sl. No. 2 (personal details), 3 (qualifications), 4 (any other qualification) and 5 (employment record) of the form.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MSSDS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of Program Associate – Accounts, with posting at Shillong, East Khasi Hills.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the MSSDS Program Associate – Accounts application?
faq.answer: The application form with testimonials, certificates and marksheets must be submitted to the MSSDS office on or before 25 November 2026 by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for MSSDS Program Associate – Accounts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor's Degree in Commerce (B. Com) from a recognized university/institution, and practical working experience with Tally ERP/Tally Prime and PFMS is mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 35 yrs.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of MSSDS Program Associate – Accounts?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is INR 22,100/- plus allowances of HRA 3000/-, Mobile 500/- and Internet 200/-.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for MSSDS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed Application Form at Annexure from the MSSDS website and submit it with testimonials, certificates and marksheets to the office of the Executive Director, MSSDS, Shillong, by 25 November 2026, 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The notice states that shortlisted candidates will be intimated subsequently.

faq.question: Q8. Who can apply for this post?
faq.answer: Applications are invited only from bonafide citizens of Meghalaya.

faq.question: Q9. Is the MSSDS Program Associate – Accounts post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is on a contractual basis for 1 (one) year (extendable), and no claim for regularization shall be entertained.

faq.question: Q10. How much experience is needed?
faq.answer: The desired experience is a minimum of 3-5 years of hands-on operational experience in accounting, bookkeeping and financial execution, including statutory compliance (GST, TDS) and voucher systems.
